close_reason: Design decision correctly captured: capability check is caller responsibility, not parse_request. No code change needed.
description: Putting capability validation in a separate function rather than inside parse_request is the right call. parse_request cannot know what capabilities a deployment supports — that is caller state. A contributor might suggest merging them ('why not just pass known into parse_request?') but that would bake a caller-specific configuration value into the general parse step, breaking the library's design of being deployment-agnostic. Keep them separate.
title: check_known_capabilities correctly placed outside parse_request — right separation of concerns
